notes: All metrics were measured by `epoch demo` on the machine in meta.provenance.
LLM agents ran in heuristic mode (no API key).

describe.name: triage
describe.title: CSAI triage cascade
describe.description: Route home-loan partner tickets to 6 ops queues through a 3-tier cost-aware cascade (fuzzy gate → classifier → LLM/kNN resolver).

space.name: normalize
space.doc: Text normalisation before matching; `hinglish` maps code-mixed tokens to English.

space.name: t1_scorer
space.doc: Fuzzy scorer against queue aliases.

space.name: t1_tau
space.doc: Tier-1 confidence floor; higher sends more tickets to slower, stronger tiers.

space.name: t1_delta
space.doc: Tier-1 margin over runner-up; guards against ambiguous tickets.

space.name: t2_features
space.doc: TF-IDF features; char n-grams resist typos and code-mixing.

space.name: t2_data
space.doc: Tier-2 training data version: base set, or base + an audited production error bank.

space.name: t2_model
space.doc: Tier-2 classifier head.

space.name: t2_C
space.doc: Inverse regularisation of logistic regression.

space.name: t2_svd_dim
space.doc: LSA projection width before the MLP.

space.name: t2_runtime
space.doc: Inference runtime for the dense head: sklearn, ONNX Runtime, or int8 dynamic-quantised ORT.

space.name: t2_tau
space.doc: Tier-2 acceptance threshold; below it tickets escalate to tier 3.

space.name: t3_policy
space.doc: Tier-3 resolver.

space.name: t3_k
space.doc: Shortlist size handed to tier 3.

space.name: t3_knn
space.doc: Neighbours in the local kNN resolver.

space.name: batch_size
space.doc: Micro-batch size; amortises vectorisation at the cost of queueing latency.
